decisions: extract_modules.py refuses any new module that reads a name left in the residue, so every assignment here is downward closed: the residue sits at the top of the dependency order and imports its children.

The mid-resolution ledger (_DEFAULTS, the two coverage keys and _DefenseLedger) moves into starting_defenses.py rather than staying in the residue the map gives it: _apply_galio and _apply_champion_revive both write through _DefenseLedger, so leaving it behind is a back-edge. It is the same concept, the resolved state mid-fold, and it keeps the residue's import count where the map put it, because starting_defenses.py is already an import the residue takes.
Residue: the resolver and the two ledger-wide folds, 242 lines, 8 internal imports, so the fan-out arm clears with the size arm.
